title: Cowboys linebacker and special teamer Marist Liufau suffers broken forearm

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Cowboys linebacker and special teamer Marist Liufau suffers broken forearm
sources.description: Cowboys outside linebacker and special teams contributor Marist Liufau exited Friday night's preseason finale early, returned with his arm in a cast and sling, and is now expected to get surgery and miss time.
